sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:7

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:7:1
items.html: One inclusion, etc., two lights in two vessels, etc., that this is included in that in one vessel: This means that every parting in spirituality is by way of disparity of form, and every joining in spirituality is equivalence of form. And therefore if, for example, one light is clothed in phase four and the second in phase three, behold, they are considered as two, since the disparity of form in them separates between them, and it is discerned that they are two separate lights in two vessels of their own. But at the time when the vessel of phase four was refined and it too remained in phase three, then the two vessels are included and become one vessel, both of them being of equal form; and likewise the two lights are included one in the other in their illumination, even though from the side of their origin in the aspect of the ten Sefirot of direct light they are two kinds — as, for instance, that this one is Ruach and that one is Nefesh.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:7:2
items.html: Two lights, etc., in two vessels, etc., the secret of love. That is, the aspect of the coupling of Neshikin [kissing], and it will be explained in its place.
